memoryBuilder.verseText: He is not here. He is alive, just as He said!

sequence.prompt: What happened on Sunday morning? Put it in order.

items.label: The women walked to the tomb
The big stone was already moved

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.

pairs.right: Nobody in a hurry folds cloths
Real — He ate fish and could be touched

application.question: Jesus is alive right now. Who could you tell the good news to?
application.followUp: Jesus was not a ghost and not just a nice memory — He ate fish in front of His friends. On Friday sin was paid for, and on Sunday death itself met Jesus and lost. Shout it: Jesus is alive!
